module_summary: UART transmitter: 4-state FSM sends start bit, 8 LSB-first data bits from a shift register, and stop bit, paced by a baud-rate divider counter.

anchors.name: state_q
anchors.why: IDLE/START/DATA/STOP controller selecting tx_o level, loading and shifting data.

anchors.name: shift_q
anchors.why: Shift register loaded from tx_data, shifted right each data bit; LSB drives tx_o.

anchors.name: tx_valid
anchors.why: Byte valid input; in IDLE loads shift register and starts frame.

anchors.name: tx_ready
anchors.why: Ready to accept a byte, asserted in IDLE state.

anchors.name: tx_data
anchors.why: Parallel byte payload loaded into shift_q.

anchors.name: tx_o
anchors.why: Serial line output muxed by state: start 0, data bit, idle/stop 1.

anchors.name: baud_cnt_q
anchors.why: Baud divider counter, cleared in IDLE, wraps at CLK_DIV-1.

anchors.name: bit_idx_q
anchors.why: Data bit counter; reaching 7 moves FSM to STOP.

anchors.name: busy_o
anchors.why: Busy level, FSM not in IDLE.

anchors.name: baud_tick
anchors.why: Bit-period tick enabling FSM transitions, shifting and bit count.

groups.name: TX controller
groups.description: Frame FSM handling byte handshake and start/data/stop sequencing.

groups.name: Shift serializer
groups.description: Shift register and bit counter serializing byte onto tx_o.

groups.name: Baud generator
groups.description: Divider counter producing baud_tick each bit period.
